verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a fair agent-fault failure where the verifier's FAIL is correct. The numeric verifier compared the submitted value 4.819301918787483e-08 against the ground-truth band 1.03e-07 to 1.23e-07 inclusive and awarded reward 0.0 because the answer sits well below the lower bound [1]. The task asked for the genome-wide average chromosomal density of filtered (>90% or <10% methylation) unique age-related CpGs per base pair in the Jackdaw genome, with the result written to /workspace/answer.txt [2][3]. Working only from the provided JD CSVs, the agent filtered rows on MethylationPercentage, counted 51 unique Pos identifiers, excluded MT from the chromosome-length denominator, and divided to obtain 4.819301918787483e-08 [4][5][6][7]; independent recomputation on the same workspace files reproduces that figure exactly [8]. The agent did explore the alternative of averaging per-chromosome densities (Def 1 ≈ 5.25e-08) versus total count over total length (Def 2 ≈ 4.82e-08), but ultimately chose Def 2 and wrote that value [5][6][7]. Neither explored figure nor the submitted answer falls inside the reference band centered near 1.03e-07 [3][5], so the agent did not genuinely accomplish the task despite a thorough trajectory; its self-checks were insufficient because it never validated against an interpretation whose magnitude matches the expected range before declaring success [6], even though the reference solve.sh prose describes the same total-over-length workflow yet hardcodes a higher stub answer [9].
